paragraphs.weather: The forecast for the weekend looks mild, with light cloud in the morning and some sunshine by early afternoon. Temperatures should sit around eighteen degrees, and the breeze from the west will stay gentle. Rain is unlikely before Monday, though the evenings will feel cooler than last week.
paragraphs.gardening: The tomatoes have finally started to ripen along the back fence, and the basil next to them is doing well in the warmer soil. The roses need a little pruning after the last bloom, and the lavender by the gate is drawing bees every afternoon. Watering in the early morning has kept everything green.
